name: cad-apprentice
description: Human-friendly CAD, fast: an AI agent designs a part with you in Autodesk Fusion, with pictures each iteration, a saved version per iteration and your own edits kept.

setup.description: Set up the kit for Fusion, or check that it still works

test.description: Run the parameter test on a design and fix what fails

print.description: Get an approved design ready to 3D print

fix.description: Find and fix why a run failed or never started

pictures.description: Take gallery pictures of a finished design
